P101.name: VIDHI
medicines: headache: Ibuprofen 400mg, 1 tablet after food as needed
fatigue: Electrolyte hydration drink + Vitamin D3 weekly capsule
chills: Keep warm with blankets + Paracetamol 500mg if accompanied by fever

P202.name: SAHASKRIT
medicines: dehydration: ORS 500ml slow sips every 30 minutes until urine turns clear
sprain: RICE protocol (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation) + Ibuprofen 400mg
anxiety: Deep breathing 4-7-8 exercises + Chamomile tea / Quiet rest
fatigue: Electrolyte hydration drink + Vitamin D3 weekly capsule
weakness: Multivitamin with B-Complex, 1 tablet daily after lunch

P303.name: ANSH
medicines: acne: Benzoyl peroxide 2.5% gel, apply small dot at night on clean skin
chills: Keep warm with blankets + Paracetamol 500mg if accompanied by fever
hiccups: Drink glass of cold water quickly or swallow teaspoon of sugar

P404.name: Sham
medicines: stomach cramp: Drotaverine 40mg, 1 tablet as needed after food
joint pain: Glucosamine supplement + Paracetamol 500mg twice daily
back pain: Diclofenac gel apply locally + Paracetamol 500mg as needed
body pain: Aceclofenac 100mg, 1 tablet twice daily after food
